text:
Anna Rivera: Heads up — PR #4123 (migration-guide + SDK snippets) is failing docs CI and is blocked from merging. Anyone around for a quick lint/code-snippet fix?
Mike Chen: Can you paste the PR link?
Anna Rivera: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 — CI logs below, main issues: unclosed code fence, a broken relative anchor, and Python SDK snippet import mismatch.
docs-preview-bot: docs-preview failed for branch 'pr-4123' — preview generation error for /migration/upgrade-v2.md (rendering aborted).
ci-bot: md-lint error MD033: unclosed code fence at line 102.
ci-bot: linkcheck: broken internal anchor '#sdk-python-example' in upgrade-v2.md -> target not found.
ci-bot: vale: SentenceCase rule triggered on 'Upgrade v2 notes' paragraph (suggest rewording).
Lee Patel: I can take the anchor + fence fix. Quick plan: close the fence, rename anchor to `sdk-python-example-usage` and update the link. Will open a tiny commit.
Anna Rivera: Also flagging the SDK snippet: it uses `from redwood import Client` but the Python package in our snippet should be `from redwood_api import Client` for v0.3. That causes copy-paste errors in examples. I'll change the snippet and add a `pip install redwood_api>=0.3` note.
Samir Gupta: I'm OOO until 3pm PT. If you get 2 approvals before then, feel free to merge; otherwise hold until I can give final ack.
Lee Patel: Pushed commit `fix/md-fence-anchor-sdk` to PR. CI re-run requested. @Mike @Samir PTAL.
ci-bot: Re-run started for PR #4123. md-lint: passed. linkcheck: 1 remaining external 404 (old blog link). vale: still flags one passive-voice sentence in the migration note.
Mike Chen: I can reword the sentence to active voice and swap the blog link to the archived copy. Will push a commit in a minute.
Samir Gupta: Reviewed changes, lgtm. Merge when green :thumbsup: .
Anna Rivera: Merged at 2387654615 — thanks everyone. I'll file a follow-up issue to replace the flaky external blog link with an archived URL and add a brief note to the SDK snippets checklist so this import mismatch doesn't recur.
